requirements.requirement: Keep sewing supplies tidy - compartmentalized storage
requirements.evidence: 3-cell base (piece:0,0,0;full + 1,-1,0 + 1,0,0) with bins: bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-div2 (2 compartments), bin:1,-1,0~hex-bin-full-div2 (2 compartments), bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full-cup (center ring keeps tall tools upright)

Full-depth bins used; dressed with solder-reel as spool analogue (tape-gaffer too large for compartment, solder-reel fits); true thread spools not in prop catalog, represented by available spool-like props
prop:1 heap-standoffs-div3, prop:2 heap-nuts-div3, prop:6 heap-standoffs-div3 in bins represent small sorted notions, each in own compartment half-cell
bin:1,0,0 cup ring holds tweezers (prop:3) and pliers (prop:4) as scissor analogues; no scissor prop exists in catalog, so pliers/tweezers show upright tool storage

finish.summary: Compact 3-cell sewing tidy: two divided full-depth bins for spools/notions and one cup bin for upright scissors/tools. Dressed with representative props to show use; checks pass mesh clear.

lines.label: pvc-section-double (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
